text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Did you two really put together this "Top 
16 Classic Mile Races" collection for me!?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Chrono-chan picked the video clips, 
and I edited them together♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Chrono-chan spent days picking out videos 
for me. Her love for racing is truly 
wonderful, isn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"No, I was just doing what I love...! 
Without your editing, Love-chan, it never 
would have turned out to be such high 
quality...!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
So that means it was made by combining the 
best parts of both of you! That's 100 
miles of emotion☆

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, huh? Looks like there's 
something more after the race footage?"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"To tell the truth, whenever I hear 
Gran-chan whistling the fanfare, I get so 
hyped up—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
W-Waaaah...!? That's, um, a personal 
message, so not right here in front of 
everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, looks like Chrono-chan's secret 
crush was found out right away♡

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
We actually recorded a video message from 
all of us too. Including some embarrassing 
things we can't normally bring ourselves 
to say♪

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah...! My heart's racing at 120 miles 
an hour!\nWell then, I'll take my time 
watching it later!\nThank you both so, so 
much♪"
